result.stdout:
ModelSync CLI

Usage:
  modelsync version
  modelsync validate --scripts <directory>
  modelsync run --provider <provider> --connection-env <variable> --scripts <directory> --dry-run
  modelsync run --provider <provider> --connection-env <variable> --scripts <directory> --apply [--report-md <path>] [--report-json <path>]

Providers:
  sqlserver, mysql, mariadb, postgresql, sqlite

Options:
  --connection-env <name>     Reads the connection string from an environment variable. Default: MODELSYNC_CONNECTION_STRING.
  --connection <value>        Inline compatibility option; may be visible in process listings.
  --history-schema <schema>   Defaults to sec.
  --legacy-profile            Applies MigrationCompatibilityProfiles.LegacyEmbeddedSql.
  --dry-run                   Compares registered scripts without applying them.
  --apply                     Explicitly confirms migration execution.
